instruction: A candid wide-shot documentary photograph captures an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor, wooden borders, and white walls. On the right side of the frame, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing toward the left. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) steps forward, facing right, and reaches out with her left hand to touch the man's (R1) chest. An office printer is visible in the background against the white wall. The scene is evenly illuminated by bright overhead lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
